These are awesome set up blocks they are spot on in accuracy and each block has many features very useful for multi tool set ups. I really like the variety of angles on the edge of one side. With each block per size you can check or set depths from how high you want the blade or how wide you want the cut to how deep you want the dado. Each bar is finely machined, ground, printed and coated to perfection. This all said if you need a set of set up blocks like these buy these you will not find a better set. Very Pleased with my purchase. Almost forgot shipping was lightning fast!!!

petit blocs, l'air de rien mais, combien efficace pour mesurer la profondeur d'une mèche de toupie ou la hauteur d'une lame de scie....ou tout autres outils demandant un ajustement d'une précision absolue........sans oublier les nombreux angles pratiques et la lecture facile gravé au laser sur chaque blocs, trop satisfait.....WOW! These setup blocks are accurate and easy to use. The carrying case latch is a bit weak but that’s not a big deal. If it breaks then I’ll just use the foam insert in a plywood divider in the drawer where I keep them.

I'm a Precision machinist with 31 years on the bench. But when I get home from building parts for rockets..I like to work with wood to keep my sanity. I've been hoping for a set of accurate but inexpensive setup blocks for some time and had ordered several..But returned them all due to them being wildly inaccurate. Some big or small by as much as.022"! That is until today.. This set is absolutely OUTSTANDING! I immediately threw my Mitutoyo caliper on every single one and they are definitely closer than any reasonable woodworking project would need. Plus or minus.001". I have several Vevor products and I have to be honest here.. Ive been SUPER impressed with every single one of them. Including my table saw miter gage. Buy this set with absolute confidence!
i’ve already used these multiple times. They’re a huge time saver, provide great accuracy for multiple woodworking jobs.
I've purchased other sets and they seem to fall short of differing sizes. This set has had every measurement I've needed. Would recommend.

Received my bars and the first thing I did was to check dimensions and tolerance. I have to say that these were as perfect as they can be in the tolerance stated. The pictures are a few examples of the verification of the thicknesses and dimensions I made. I used good quality vernier calipers for the checks and a separate basic digital set that was easier to photograph for these pictures. Both gave good results. I am very happy with the purchase and the consistency of these bars.

you can use these setup block in a number of ways to set depth of table saw blade or router bit and very accurately set the fence. By combining several blocks you can get almost any measurement you want. Also handy are the angle gauges to set or measure many different angles. The case they come in keeps them organized.

Very happy with the Vevor setup blocks. Pros: Well made, easy to read and very accurate. I also like the foam insert in the storage case. It is marked with each blocks dimension. Con: The storage case is cheap plastic. Mine arrived damaged. The reason for the four star rating. I chose the Vevor blocks because they were the most accurate in that price range. A competitor had a nicer storage case but they were not as accurate. I'll take accuracy over a pretty case. I reported the damage to Vevor, who were very quick to respond. Although they do not have replacement cases, we were able to amicable resolution. I suggested Vevor consider a better quality storage case commencerate with the quality of their setup blocks.
